$comment: Performance budgets for the HusnainBlogger 500 Mini Tools platform. Owner: MA1-PerfSEO. ALL values are TARGETS enforced in CI (Lighthouse CI, implemented by MA4) — they are not claims about current performance. Budgets fail the build when exceeded after the Phase-0 grace period (see docs/architecture/PERFORMANCE.md §7).

ci.$comment: What MA4 implements (scripts/check-budgets.mjs is the wrapper; Lighthouse CI does the measuring).
ci.artifacts: LHCI JSON uploaded per run; budgets compared in check-budgets.mjs; failures annotate the PR.
ci.cadence: Every PR touching app/ or data/; nightly full 500-page audit is optional (MA4 decides cost/benefit).
ci.sampleStrategy: All 10 templates x 1 representative tool page + all 10 hubs + homepage + /tools/ index (23 pages), mobile preset.

coreWebVitals.$comment: Measured on mobile, Moto G4-class throttling, 75th percentile of sampled tool pages.

javascript.$comment: Gzipped transfer size of ALL JS requested for initial interactivity of one page. Astro ships zero JS by default; only islands count. Phase-0: measured and reported, not a hard gate.
rules: No barrel file may import all 500 tool logic modules into one graph.
Shared helpers (validation, url-state, format) form ONE shared chunk; per-tool modules must not duplicate them.
Third-party scripts are banned on tool pages unless the Lead approves a named exception with a weight budget.

pageWeight.$comment: Total transfer size per page (HTML+CSS+JS+images+fonts), gzipped where applicable.

resources.css: No render-blocking CSS beyond the critical inlined <style>; per-template CSS code-split by Astro automatically.
resources.fonts: Subset WOFF2 only, font-display: swap. Max 2 families. Self-hosted from app/public/fonts/.
resources.images: AVIF primary, WebP fallback; explicit width/height on every image; loading=lazy + decoding=async below the fold.
